title: The Wise People of Chelm Move the Mountain
summary: The wise people of Chelm need to build a synagogue, but there is no room. What will they come up with this time?
pages: The wise people of Chelm wanted to build a synagogue.
But there was no room to build it, because of the mountain.
The wise people of Chelm sat for seven days and seven nights. They sat and they thought.
And at last they decided to move the mountain.
They went to the mountain and started to push.

They pushed and pushed, and they got hot.
So they took off their coats and kept on pushing.

A thief passed by, saw the coats,
and stole them.

The wise people of Chelm looked back,
and they couldn't see their coats.
"Wow!" said the wise people of Chelm.

"We pushed the mountain so far
that we can't even see our coats anymore!"
